item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】FLAC - Dua Lipa - Dua Lipa (Complete Edition) [+Bonus Tracks] [FLAC + MP3]
item.description:
​
Hey everyone! Today I want to share a custom compilation I made for Dua Lipa's debut era.
I took the official Complete Edition and expanded it with some essential acoustic versions, official remixes, the summer collaboration "My Love", and a dedicated section for her best unreleased tracks/demos.
Tracks 01 to 36 are in pristine FLAC (Lossless) quality, and the unreleased tracks (37 to 41) are in MP3.
